units: <cite ref="Pesachim 114a:6">Pes. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>ברכת היין ת׳ … ת׳ ושאינו ת׳ ת׳ קודם</he> to say the blessing over wine is a constant duty, but the blessing over the day (festival) is not a constant (only a periodical) duty: where there is a constant duty and one not constant, the constant duty has the precedence; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 10:3">Tosef. ib. X, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 6:10">Tosef. Ber. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:1">V</cite>), 1; Y. ib. VIII, beg. 11ᵈ.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 10:1">Zeb. X, 1</cite> <he>כל הת׳ מחבירו וכ׳</he> that which is more constant than another thing has the precedence over the other thing: the daily offering precedes the Musaf, the Sabbath Musaf precedes that of the New Moon &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תְּדִירִין</he>.
Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ bot. שהם ת׳ בעבודה because they are constantly on duty.—תְּדִירָה (adv.) steadily.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:8">Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 4:4">Tosef. Par. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 3:7">III</cite>), 7, v. <cite ref="G00541"><he>זָמַר</he> II</cite>.
